title: Evidence screen cleaned up
details: Evidence cards now show a compact evidence summary instead of dumping the full saved answer or video timestamp transcript onto the screen
Guided videos show as Guided video with duration and prompt count while the full prompt timestamps remain stored with the evidence
Photo evidence shows as Photo + written explanation without filling the card with the learner's full text
Downloaded evidence uses the same clean card layout so old test notes no longer dominate the screen
Evidence thumbnails now match records by their exact saved order and evidence ID instead of guessing from similar card text
summary: Evia v136 fixes the broken Evidence screen layout and media matching.
changes: Removed raw answer text from evidence-list cards
Stopped legacy thumbnail decoration from owning the same row
Moved the offline shell to v136
